scope: Exactly EXT-F-4131-T01 through EXT-F-4136-T01; source review only. No browser, build, fixture, upload, deletion, or runtime execution.

EXT-F-4131-T01.finding: Valid, invalid-duration, and returned-video oracles match video.ts:30-49,69-166. The manual runner bypasses the optional tabCapture gate at dispatch.ts:792-802; the proposal correctly leaves denial unverified. An owned tab, granted permission, receipt, and retained remote file are still required.

EXT-F-4132-T01.finding: The manual runner directly invokes record_demo in the side panel (ToolsView.tsx:453-462). recorder.ts:20,89-92 keeps active state in that module instance, while bootstrap.ts:550-552 handles captured events in the service worker instance. No cross-context recorder event relay is present. A panel start/status/stop can therefore report an active recording yet save zero captured steps. This is a source-supported path gap, not a runtime-reproduced product defect. The NOT_EXECUTABLE classification and conditional post-repair steps are justified.

EXT-F-4133-T01.finding: list_demos reads the local summary index (storage.ts:32-36), and JSON null fails the object schema (demos.ts:198-208; ToolsView.tsx:414-419). An owned saved fixture is required. The list does not prove a body or cloud synchronization.

EXT-F-4134-T01.finding: The handler hydrates an absent body, redacts sensitive input_text, and returns the full demo (demos.ts:215-229). Empty demo_id fails schema. Cloud read errors can throw, while a known reference with missing body returns demo_body_unavailable (demos.ts:54-80; cloud-sync.ts:162-178). A bogus ID is only a missing oracle if it is confirmed unowned and absent; do not classify any read refusal as demo_not_found.

EXT-F-4135-T01.finding: The privileged confirmation is bypassed by ToolsView.tsx:453-462, so the dry_run:true restriction is appropriate. replay.ts:56-65 reloads or navigates the start URL, and lines 91-146 can also navigate to later recorded URLs and execute scroll steps during dry run. Only selector-driven DOM actions skip mutation (line 285). The procedure must explicitly bound every recorded navigation and scroll on the owned fixture and not call dry run a complete side-effect-free replay.

EXT-F-4136-T01.finding: storage.ts:70-82 removes the local index/body while scheduling the cloud tombstone without awaiting it. describe_demo then calls getDemoOrHydrate (demos.ts:219-221; cloud-sync.ts:162-174), which can fetch and restore a still-live cloud row. Thus immediate demo_not_found is not a reliable local-cleanup oracle, and a second delete need not return No demo. Verify local absence with list_demos and exact-ID local storage evidence; assess cloud tombstone and independent post-sync read separately. Preserve the owned ID until this is resolved.

cross_case_limits: All six remain NOT_EXECUTABLE without the receipt-bound build and owned fixtures. Separate member/admin results and warm/extension-reload runs are future work, not pass evidence.

Manual Tools Run validates JSON/Zod then calls handler.run directly. It does not exercise dispatcher Ask/Act confirmation, admin enforcement, optional-permission denial, or agent tab assignment (ToolsView.tsx:390-462; dispatch.ts:792-837).
The proposed video artifact has no deletion step in this handler. Demo cloud save/delete are asynchronous; exact local results do not prove remote completion.
No tests were run because this review changes only a source-review JSON artifact and the brief excludes runtime and heavy checks.
